['we have agreed to offer you 15% of the total money 5% for any expenses that may arise', 'I AGREE THAT 30% OF THIS MONEY WILL BE FOR YOU AS FOREIGN PARTNER, IN RESPECT TO THE PROVISION OF A FOREIGN ACCOUNT AND 70% WOULD BE FOR ME;']

Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
